Anomaly fill scale

Source: R/visualization.R
scale_fill_anomaly.Rd

Color scale for climate anomalies with blue for negative values, white at zero, and red for positive values.

Usage

scale_fill_anomaly(...)

Arguments

...

Additional arguments passed to scale_fill_gradient2.

Value

A ggplot2 scale object.

References

Wilke, C. O. (2019). Fundamentals of data visualization. O'Reilly Media. ISBN 978-1492031086

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ggplot2)
data(climate_monthly)
nao <- climate_monthly[climate_monthly$index == "NAO", ]

ggplot(nao, aes(x = date, y = value)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = value)) +
  scale_fill_anomaly() +
  theme_climate()
} # }
